$comment: ⚖ USER RULING 2026-11-11: "Add the directional gates for now, but make a note to reexamine this later." A PER-ROOM TABLE, licensed for now in place of a general derivation; read by seedlingNoHitDirectionalGates.js (whose header carries the ruling and the direction to re-examine). Each gate names a wallflyer band by its flyers (the tiles come from seedlingWallFlyerBands.wallFlyerBands, never typed here), the compass direction of movement that costs an arm (y grows down, so N is south to north), the witnessed arm set as engine flags, and its witnesses in scripts/procgen/seedling-wallflyer-nohit-plans.json: `notFound` (the no-item searches of the blocked direction that ended without a plan), `arms` (one game-verified no-hit plan per arm, blocked direction) and `free` (game-verified no-item plans of the reverse direction). A witness id missing from the plans file refuses the gate by name. `unwitnessed` names an arm a gate does NOT offer although the derivation says it disarms, with why and the follow-up, so it is not silently absent; the reader refuses an entry whose gate does not exist, whose arm the gate offers, or whose arm has a witness there.
reexamine: TO BE RE-EXAMINED (the user, 2026-11-11). The general rule slice rules-no-hit-l22 suggested, not built: a band is passable with no item where the room offers a waiting spot off the ray at the far end of every flight. NOT FOUND is a search budget, never "impossible". Fire was not found; it is not an arm here. The Wand is an arm of L22 north (game witness l22-25-21-wand, slice rules-nohit-wand-crosscheck, ⚖ Robert 2026-11-15 "Wand L22 + CI cross-check") and of L25 east (game witness l25-26-22-wand, slice rules-l25-wand-witness: a Bob-aware hand line along row 5 that stuns one Bob and parks the struck flyers on both, ⚖ Robert 2026-11-21 "Wire it", slice rules-l25-wand-arm); `unwitnessed` is empty. The waiting-spot rule is necessary but not sufficient where chasers share the room: L25 turns on its Bobs (a parked flyer holds them) and its pushable block, which a general rule would have to model. The derivation `scripts/procgen/derive-seedling-wallflyer-nohit.mjs --check` cross-checks every gate's direction against the rooms' own physics; it is a CROSS-CHECK, never a rule source (it sees flyers only, and its verdicts are knife-edge).

gates.says: south to north: from the L25/L30 doors to the L21/L29 doors, across the lower flyer row
west to east: from the L26 door to the L22/L28 doors, across the two flyer columns
